tools.name: search_securities
tools.description: Use this when the user gives an ambiguous company name or ticker and you need to resolve it before valuation or comparison. Search is limited to the ValuEdge-supported security universe.

tools.description: Use this when the user wants a bounded ValuEdge stock screen for research candidates such as undervalued, quality, dividend, large-cap, or positive-free-cash-flow stocks. tools.name: get_my_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge portfolio, holdings, market value, fair-value coverage, allocation, concentration, or risk context. Never accepts a user id and never returns another user's data.

tools.name: analyze_my_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks for their own portfolio concentration, sector or currency allocation, fair-value coverage, or risk context. Explain evidence and limitations without giving buy, sell, or hold instructions.

tools.name: get_my_watchlist
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge watchlist, including current price, canonical fair value, margin of safety, quality signals, and data freshness. Never accepts a user id.

tools.name: get_my_smart_alerts
tools.description: Use this when the authenticated user asks to review their own ValuEdge Smart Alerts and the valuation context behind them. Never exposes another user's alerts or changes alert state.
